description: Pre-implementation baseline data for Project EQUILIBRIUM including national prescribing patterns and pilot site characteristics

data_files.description: Monthly national and regional antidepressant prescribing data for 2019 (baseline year)
data_files.notes: Data shown is sample for Q1 2019. Full dataset includes all 12 months.

data_files.description: Characteristics of pilot medical schools and GP practices at baseline
data_files.source: Site registration forms, practice list data, national datasets
data_files.notes: Practice names anonymized. Deprivation scores are Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) 2019.

pilot_practices.interpretation: Low baseline response rates and poor guideline concordance consistent with national patterns

medical_schools.note: Measured in student clinical placements - students prescribing concordant with NICE CG90 in only 29% of depression cases

data_collection_methods.national_prescribing: Extracted from NHS Digital Prescription Cost Analysis, publicly available dataset
data_collection_methods.practice_characteristics: Practice registration forms, NHS Digital practice-level data
data_collection_methods.baseline_outcomes: Chart review of 30 randomly selected depression cases per practice (Jan-Dec 2019)
data_collection_methods.student_outcomes: Final year clinical placement assessments, supervisor ratings

completeness.baseline_chart_review: 95% (228/240 cases reviewed, 12 excluded due to incomplete records)
